data.content: With great enthusiasm, we undertook the task of naming and developing the brand for one of the largest and most modern residential complexes in Albania.

We came up with an extraordinary name for a residence, but beautiful and meaningful at the same time: "SeeHëna," combining the words in Albanian "Sikur-like,Hëna-Moon” but used it in a stylized form by inlcluding the English language in order to give it an International feel.

We also adapted the slogan to match the complex’s name and purpose: "Where dreams come to life."
After naming the main residence, we continued with the same method in naming other villas and apartments such as: SeeVesa (Like Dew), SeeDielli (Like Sun), SeeEra (Like Wind), SeeGjethe (Like Leaf), SeeDrita (Like Light), SeeZana (Like Fairy), SeeJeta (Like Life), SeeMagji (Like Magic), SeeYjet (Like Stars), etc.

We also designed the catalogs and website for the residence.
We remain committed to making dreams come true by continuing to work with great enthusiasm on SeeHëna’s exciting upcoming projects.
